Official document (PDF) · Draft S/2022/495 · Meeting record S/PV.9073

United Nations S/RES/2638 (2022) Security Council Distr.: General 22 June 2022

Resolution 2638 (2022) Adopted by the Security Council at its 9073rd meeting, on 22 June 2022

The Security Council, Noting with regret the death of Judge Antônio Augusto Cançado Trindade on 29 May 2022, Noting further that a vacancy in the International Court of Justice for the remainder of the term of office of the deceased Judge has occurred and must be filled in accordance with the terms of the Statute of the Court, Noting that, in accordance with article 14 of the Statute, the date of the election to fill the vacancy shall be fixed by the Security Council, Decides that the election to fill the vacancy shall take place on 4 November 2022 at a meeting of the Security Council and at a meeting of the General Assembly at its seventy-seventh session.

22-09857 (E) *2209857*
